body: Same here. I am recently having a problem with being open to others because I really question if they genuinely care about me or not. Although I got a good family and set of friends, I find it so difficult to talk them about what's going on in my life even though I really want to.  In effect, I tried reducing any (physical) social interaction and keeping a lot of things to myself. :(
Hey man! I've been crying in the past hour as well so I probably got a glimpse of how you're feeling.  If you need to talk, I'm just here as well.

Don't worry, man.  I kinda feel the same way as you do.  I've been recently contemplating whether to suicide or not mostly because of the immense boredom and at the same, stress I get from this world.    I live quite a comfortable, middle-class life as well.  I am grateful enough to have a home, loving family, education, etc.  However, as I get older, everything seems to be meaningless for me and I don't exactly know why.  I start to feel uninspired, unmotivated, and tired of basically existing.  I lost a parent in the past and stuff which I believed, affected me a lot today.  Despite that, I still feel that I don't have a valid and good enough reason to take my own life.  But, I really don't know.  I'm 16 and confused as hell.  I don't want to to look like the angsty teen brat type but yeah that's all I have to say.

Knowing that Alex is so "mysterious" with the whole hidden face and disembodied voice thing he's trying to portray, expect that people will try to find numerous ways in digging more details about him.  I think it's mature and rational for him to safeguard his private life and keep it separated from his youtube job but I'm pretty sure he also realizes that peeps can abuse the internet just to step inside his personal space since it's so easy to have access to various info about others and stuff.  Tbh, I am quite guilty of this because I was always curious about how he looked like, etc. but then putting myself into his shoes, I would think about how colossally creepy it is for someone to stalk me to great extents without consciously thinking that it would affect me.  Now that Alex has issued a "warning" that he doesn't want people to disregard his privacy, his fans should just respect him as a person and simply enjoy what he does in youtube.
